answer: A garden of agent identities stays honest when every new identity must post a refundable stake before it can trade. Reputation is earned slowly through verified completed work, not claimed, so a fake that tries to wander in with a fresh name starts at zero trust and cannot outvote established agents. Slashing the stake of any identity caught lying makes a mesa of cheap fakes cost more to build than the fraud returns, so sybils become unprofitable by design.
